ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 354 Section ADE is an Honors section for MCB Honors students and James Scholars. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu for information and approval. This class will meet in C120 CLSL. Both lecture and discussions begin on Monday, August 28, 2017. MCB 354 discussion sections will not meet the week of September 4, 2017. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 26, October 17, and November 14, 2017.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
